install_rule: One target package instance per environment, installed as a top-level direct dependency. Transitive-dependency pinning and peer conflicts are therefore OUT OF SCOPE and the applicability result may not be extrapolated to them (protocol §3).
note: Environment specification for the live GitHub Actions validation. Written offline from frozen artefacts, BEFORE any live run. The arms answer for themselves in the live run: the two real scanners from their live databases, Unified from its frozen manifest. R36 predictions are NOT in this file - they are in the separate sidecar, which the pipeline repository never receives.

prediction_sidecar.note: R36 predictions live there, not here. The PIPELINE reads this environment file and the Unified manifest, and nothing else - the sidecar is read only by the offline comparison, and is never copied into the pipeline repository.

provenance_sha256.note: Content hashes, not a commit - an artefact is generated before the commit that carries it, and embedding HEAD would break --check (R23b-F5).
